requirements.title: ERROR_UNIT identifies the preconnected error-reporting unit
requirements.source: S16.10.2.9 p1 unit identity; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: ERROR_UNIT is a default integer scalar constant identifying the processor-dependent preconnected external unit used for error reporting.

pending.error-unit-default-integer-scalar: Import ERROR_UNIT, assert KIND(ERROR_UNIT) equals KIND(0) and RANK(ERROR_UNIT) equals 0; mutate the imported name to INPUT_UNIT.
pending.error-unit-preconnected-write-succeeds: Initialize an IOSTAT variable to -777, execute WRITE(ERROR_UNIT,'(A)',IOSTAT=status) 'batch211-error-unit-probe', and assert status is zero; mutate the unit to -1.

requirements.title: ERROR_UNIT may be the same as OUTPUT_UNIT
requirements.source: S16.10.2.9 p1 permission; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: The ERROR_UNIT value may be the same as OUTPUT_UNIT.

pending.error-unit-output-unit-equality-permitte: No portable oracle may require ERROR_UNIT and OUTPUT_UNIT to be equal or distinct; future fixtures must not compare them except to avoid invalid -1.

requirements.title: ERROR_UNIT is not -1
requirements.source: S16.10.2.9 p1 final sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF473.
requirements.definition: The value of ERROR_UNIT shall not be -1.
